en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Hassan, from Musa Bin Bakr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ibrahim<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Jihad of the wife is goodness with the husband’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Hassan from Musa ibn Bakr who has said the following: “Abu Ibrahim, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Jihad (struggle for the cause of Allah) of a woman is her living a proper spousal life.’”
